name: Compact 100 LPH Commercial RO
summary: High-capacity 100 LPH commercial RO system with dual pump and membrane setup, advanced filtration, and external tank connectivity for continuous high-volume water purification.
features: Connect with any External Tank or Water Cooler
ABS Premium Grade Storage Tank and Cabinet Quality

The Compact 100 LPH Commercial RO is a powerful and efficient high-capacity purification system designed for commercial environments requiring continuous and large-volume water supply. With a purification capacity of 100 litres per hour, it ensures reliable performance throughout the day.

This system features advanced RO water purification technology that effectively removes dissolved impurities, heavy metals, chemicals, and harmful contaminants. The 3-in-1 Sediment | Carbon | Sediment filter provides superior pre-filtration, removing dust, rust, and chlorine while protecting internal components and extending membrane life.
